title: Service Quotas: viewing and raising account limits

kcs.statement: Service Quotas shows the default and applied quotas (formerly called service limits) for AWS services in each Region of an account, lets you request a quota increase, and can trigger a CloudWatch alarm when usage nears a quota.

problem_ideas: A launch fails because the account has hit its limit of running On-Demand vCPUs in us-east-1: where do you request more?
A team wants a warning when Elastic IP usage reaches 80% of its quota: which two services work together?
Trusted Advisor flags a quota at 85%: which service do you use to actually raise it?
True or false: a quota raised in eu-west-1 also applies in ap-south-1.
Old name, new name: what were service quotas called in older AWS documentation?
Distractor drill: 'request an increase to the number of VPCs per Region' with options Service Quotas, Trusted Advisor, Organizations, Cost Explorer.
